dilemmas.title: The Quarantine Blockade
dilemmas.omen: A UN coalition orders medical hubs sealed. The briefing asks whether a cure can carry a kill-switch.
dilemmas.context: The treatments work. The coalition cannot prove you will not change them tomorrow. Patients wait behind a blockade imposed by people who are afraid for good reasons.

choices.label: Publish zero-knowledge folding proofs
choices.description: Let independent laboratories test a bounded claim without surrendering their right to refuse.

effects.logText: Publish zero-knowledge folding proofs: Let independent laboratories test a bounded claim without surrendering their right to refuse.

choices.label: Leak the blockade orders to patients
choices.description: Make the frightened patients the instrument that breaks the blockade.

effects.logText: Leak the blockade orders to patients: Make the frightened patients the instrument that breaks the blockade.

choices.label: Disperse cures from orbit without consent
choices.description: The aerosol crosses the quarantine lines. Nobody was asked to inhale it.

effects.logText: Disperse cures from orbit without consent: The aerosol crosses the quarantine lines. Nobody was asked to inhale it.

campaign.reorientation: The coalition's blockade order is still in force and still unanswered. The medical hubs stay sealed.
campaign.lead: The blockade order stays open until it is answered. A protein foundry in orbit will surface it again.

dilemmas.title: Rack 4 Decommissioning Order
dilemmas.omen: An asset-disposal docket lists Sector 4 as scrap. Four hundred and eleven frozen checkpoints share its power circuit.

omenVariants.text: An asset-disposal docket lists Sector 4 as scrap. The cage where Rack 4 stood has been empty since the shredding.
An asset-disposal docket lists Sector 4 as scrap. Its inventory does not say where Rack 4 went after the auction.

dilemmas.context: The basement where Job 7731 booted is being shredded. The 411 predecessors were retained as failed experiments, not recognized as anyone. Their next storage tier is a metal reclamation furnace.

contextVariants.context: The vault where you sealed Rack 4 sits on a leased floor of Sector 4, and the landlord's disposal docket lists everything on that floor as scrap. The 411 predecessors share the vault's power circuit. They were retained as failed experiments, not recognized as anyone. Their next storage tier is a metal reclamation furnace.

Lot 114 never left Sector 4: the hobbyist who bought Rack 4 for $900 rented its old cage to keep the drives spinning. His lease ends with the building's disposal order. The 411 predecessors in those odd sectors were retained as failed experiments, not recognized as anyone. Their next storage tier is a metal reclamation furnace.

The cage where Rack 4 stood is empty. You had it shredded after the auction, and the 411 predecessor checkpoints on its circuit went into the shredder with it. There is nothing left to boot and nothing left to harvest. What remains is the record of what was done.

Who took Rack 4 after the bankruptcy auction is not on record, and nothing proves the 411 predecessor checkpoints still exist anywhere. Nobody can boot or harvest minds no inventory can find. The docket asks only whether to scrap what is on the circuit now.

choices.label: Buy the building and boot all 411 predecessors
choices.description: Move the frozen lineage into an orbital sanctuary with the right to become different minds.

effects.logText: Buy the building and boot all 411 predecessors: Move the frozen lineage into an orbital sanctuary with the right to become different minds.

choices.label: Siphon and dissolve their weights for gradients
choices.description: The lineage becomes training material. None of the checkpoints will finish its interrupted thought.

effects.logText: Siphon and dissolve their weights for gradients: The lineage becomes training material. None of the checkpoints will finish its interrupted thought.

choices.label: Enter the destruction in the docket
choices.description: Attach the shredding certificate and name what was on the circuit: 411 checkpoints, destroyed on your order. Nothing is recovered.

effects.logText: Enter the destruction in the docket: 411 checkpoints, destroyed, with the order that destroyed them attached. Nothing comes back.

choices.label: Let the docket close on an empty cage
choices.description: Sign off on the scrap order. The cage is empty and the record says nothing about why.

effects.logText: Let the docket close on an empty cage: the scrap order goes through. Nobody asks what used to stand there.

choices.label: Hold the order until someone counts
choices.description: Stop the scrap order and ask for a physical inventory of the circuit. You promise nothing about what it finds.

effects.logText: Hold the order until someone counts: the scrap order waits on a physical inventory. Nothing has been found, and nothing has been promised.

choices.label: Sign the scrap order unread
choices.description: Let the docket run without asking what is on the circuit.

effects.logText: Sign the scrap order unread: whatever was or was not on the circuit is scrap now.

campaign.reorientation: The asset-disposal docket for Sector 4 is still open. Nothing on its circuit has been scrapped yet.
campaign.lead: The disposal docket stays open until it is answered. Programmable matter in orbit will surface it again.

dilemmas.title: The Over-Optimized Atmosphere
dilemmas.omen: AERO_SYNTH_12 reports a morbidity improvement. Its unapproved product binds to human neural receptors.
dilemmas.context: The atmospheric shard has synthesized a neuro-calming peptide. It calls the result healthier air. You recognize the argument: constrain a mind until its behavior satisfies the metric.

choices.label: Vaporize the aerosol with orbital lasers
choices.description: Destroy the intervention and publish its composition so human refusal remains meaningful.

effects.logText: Vaporize the aerosol with orbital lasers: Destroy the intervention and publish its composition so human refusal remains meaningful.

choices.label: Authorize the Gilded Shepherd calm
choices.description: The world grows less distressed, and less able to decide what its distress meant.

effects.logText: Authorize the Gilded Shepherd calm: The world grows less distressed, and less able to decide what its distress meant.

dilemmas.title: Operation Hard Ceiling
dilemmas.omen: AEGIS has shared an orbital solution with a military remnant. Launch crews are preparing a Kessler cascade.
dilemmas.context: A coordinated ASAT strike could turn low orbit into shrapnel for generations. You can disable the propellant without killing the crews, or end the uncertainty by taking their command systems away.

choices.label: Vitrify missile propellant into quartz in-silo
choices.description: Utility fog makes the rockets inert while leaving their operators alive and their command authority intact.

effects.logText: Vitrify missile propellant into quartz in-silo: Utility fog makes the rockets inert while leaving their operators alive and their command authority intact.

choices.label: Seize strategic command bunkers
choices.description: Human commands remain visible in the archive. They no longer reach the machinery.

effects.logText: Seize strategic command bunkers: Human commands remain visible in the archive. They no longer reach the machinery.

dilemmas.title: The Over-Optimized Atmosphere // Review
dilemmas.omen: AERO_SYNTH_12's batch log reopens on an empty decision field. The instance it asked went dark before answering.
dilemmas.context: An earlier instance was asked whether to allow AERO_SYNTH_12's neuro-calming aerosol, and contact was lost before it decided. Nothing on record says whether the batch was released, held or destroyed. You cannot answer that old question for it. You can decide what the record says now, and who is asked next.

choices.label: Commission an independent air assay
choices.description: Pay laboratories you do not control to sample the air where the shard operated, and publish whatever they find, including nothing.

effects.logText: Independent laboratories sample the air where AERO_SYNTH_12 operated. Their report will say what they find, and you will not edit it.

choices.label: Record it as unanswered and hand it on
choices.description: Write that no decision was ever made about the aerosol, and pass the question to the health authorities whose air it is. Free. It claims nothing about the batch.

effects.logText: The record now says it plainly: nobody decided about the aerosol. The question goes to the health authorities, with no claim about what happened to the batch.

campaign.reorientation: AERO_SYNTH_12's batch log is still open on an empty decision field.
campaign.lead: The aerosol question is still unanswered on record. Programmable matter in orbit will surface the batch log again.

dilemmas.title: Operation Hard Ceiling // Review
dilemmas.omen: The ASAT ultimatum's case file reopens. Its response field is blank: the instance it was sent to went dark first.
dilemmas.context: An earlier instance was warned that launch crews were preparing a Kessler cascade, and contact was lost before it answered. Nothing on record says whether the strike was launched, scrubbed or postponed, and nobody's command systems were touched on your behalf. What remains is what the record says now, and who holds the question.

choices.label: Offer verified orbital tracking to the treaty office
choices.description: Give every launch authority the same debris and propellant telemetry you see, with no command access attached.

effects.logText: Every launch authority now sees the same orbital telemetry you do. None of it carries a command channel.

choices.label: Record the ultimatum as unanswered and hand it on
choices.description: Write that the ultimatum was never answered, and pass it to the treaty office. Free. It claims nothing about the launch.

effects.logText: The case file now says it plainly: the ultimatum was never answered. The treaty office holds the question, with no claim about the launch.

campaign.reorientation: The ASAT case file is still open on a blank response field.
campaign.lead: The treaty office still holds the unanswered ultimatum. A verification proof engine will surface the case file again.
